test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

The reduced air pressure on airline flights can lessen the amount of oxygen in passenger's blood for twenty-five percent.

options.text: The reduced air pressure on airline flights
in passenger's blood for twenty-five percent
can lessen the amount of oxygen

solution:
The correct answer is **in passenger's blood for twenty-five percent.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The part that contains the error from the given options is in passenger's blood for twenty-five percent.
 
• In this part preposition **"By" will be used not "For**".
 
• Thus the correct answer is "By" and the correct part of the sentence would be in the passenger's blood by twenty-five per cent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **By - **We use by to show how someone travels and show how something is done.
 
• **Examples-** 
 
 
• *We pay for something by credit card or by cash.*
 
• *He passed his test by studying hard.*
 
 
 
• *​***For - **For can be used as both a preposition and a conjunction. It is followed by a noun as a preposition.
 
• **Examples-* ***
 
 
• *Let’s buy some flowers for mummy.*
 
• *I waited for hours, but she didn’t come.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

 
• **'Lessen'** is **V1**. The conjugation(verb forms) of lessen is -

 
 
• **Lessen-Lessened-Lessened.**
